post.description: Proof-only acknowledgement for one exact historical enrollment. The trusted adapter verifies the submitted proof against that enrollment's retained key commitment and DB challenge, and binds the path host, enrollment, operation and account. Current enrollment TTL does not grant authority. A revoked-family outcome is returned only for that enrollment's exact already-revoked family with matching host/account and valid monotonic epochs; exchange consumption or enrollment revocation is not required for this outcome. A no-family outcome requires an approved, revoked, unconsumed enrollment and an exhaustive no-family lookup for that enrollment; a family for a newer enrollment does not change that outcome. Missing, wrong, live or inconsistent proofs are denied. This route performs no authority DML and returns no reusable authority.

get.description: Host-only current-runtime lookup for the exact authenticated host; no request body. Unclaimed generation zero has runtime null and no fabricated UUID. Revoked or stale-epoch bindings yield runtime null and zero effective publicationSeq, leaseMs and freshnessMs. Remaining durations are server assertions, never client authority. The DTO validates wire structure only; the server enforces these state rules.
